newsitem.title: USA: Funscape changes name to Titan Energy.
newsitem.headline: Funscape changes name to Titan Energy.

text.p: Funscape Corp said Monday it has changed its the name to Titan Energy Corp Inc to reflect its recent acquisitions.
The company said its new name derives from the Latin poet Helios and means the Sun God or Sun personified.
On May 19, Funscape announced it had acquired Oil Retrieval Systems Inc for 2.5 million restricted common shares.
On June 11, the company announced a plan of reorganization to acquire substantially all of the assets of Oilex Inc for about seven million shares.
Monday it said M.O. Rife III will be president of the combined entities, adding Titan has acquired 650 oil wells in the the Corsiocana Field from Rife Oil Properties Inc.
The shallow, 800-feet-deep wells are situated on 4,500 acres about 50 miles south of Dallas.
The wells were acquired for stock, Oilex investor Allen Burditt II said last week.
